math.norm_squared: ||BA||_F^2 = sum((B^T B) * (A A^T)); rank-by-rank matrices only
math.precision: Stored FP32 factors converted exactly to FP64; contractions accumulated in FP64.
math.quantiles: Unweighted projection quantiles with linear interpolation; concatenated metric sums squared norms and inner products.
math.cancellation_policy: Fail if squared difference < -tolerance. Clamp tolerated negative squared differences to zero; likewise clamp cosine only within its derived tolerance. Count near-cancellation cases explicitly.

resource_notes.memory_policy: Buffered file reads for one active projection at a time; no tensor-file mmap, full delta matrix, model weights, or model runtime loaded.
resource_notes.overlap_note: This CPU diagnostic ran while parent-owned inference work was active. Start/end UTC and CPU/RSS are recorded for disclosure; no service or API timing was queried.

interpretation_limits: Compares effective stored weight edits, invariant to rank-factor sign/basis changes.
Preserves the NF4-derived directions; rebased factors additionally differ through CPU versus original GPU randomized SVD and rounding.
Does not simulate vLLM BF16 LoRA casts, Marlin accumulation, activation distributions, or model outputs.
Norms, cosines and relative differences are not model-quality or capability-retention measures.
